info.origin: Context Aware AI with established game terms
info.english:
Produces sun, paints plants, and occasionally attracts plants seeking portraits.

<color=#3D1400>Sun Production: </color><color=red>25 x 2 / 20s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Tap to pick up or put down the brush. While holding it, tap another plant to paint its portrait.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>5 seconds after appearing, attracts a random plant<sup>[2]</sup> with a hidden appearance<sup>[1]</sup> to the tile in front. It is removed if not painted within 30 seconds. Attracting plants has a 90-second cooldown.</color>
<color=#3D1400>[1]: </color><color=red>Its normal appearance is shown in Auto-fight & Sandbox and Custom Level.</color>
<color=#3D1400>[2]: </color><color=red>Plants that can appear from a Plant Giftbox.</color>

"Blank space holds endless possibilities," she said in an interview. "A painting may stay the same to its artist, but a thousand plants see a thousand different 花木蕾藤."</color>

announcement.origin: Context Aware AI from actual Android 4.1 announcement, using verified Blooms names. Current PC announcement is still 4.0.5.
announcement.english:
PvZ Fusion 4.1 Update

1. Odyssey: Evolved rework
Earn points each round to buy plants, upgrade the shop, or refresh its stock.
Combine cards or upgrade the shop for higher-quality cards.
Equip plant cards with multiple items for extra bonuses.
Fusions inherit the quality and equipment of both ingredients.
Zombies entering the house now cost HP instead of immediately ending the level.

2. New plants
Basic: Artsy Sunflower, Ball Cactus, 磁性卷心菜投手, 铁桶卷心菜投手, 超时空卷心菜投手, 浮空大喷菇, 大喷菇花盆, 磁力窝瓜, 保护伞窝瓜, 西瓜投射手, 三线胆小菇, 窝瓜大喷菇, 卷心菜投射手, 西瓜胆小菇, 大蒜窝瓜, 银窝瓜, 金窝瓜
Ultimate: SP Calamity-shroom, SP Avarice-shroom, 磁能窝瓜坚果, 飓风之龙, 平行时空树桩

3. New zombies
Variant: 樱桃战神僵尸
Ultimate: 海豚橄榄高坚果僵尸
Boss: 渊海三叉戟

4. Level updates
Super Random: Question Mark Battle: Paint portraits of the random plants Artsy Sunflower attracts, then use them to fight the zombies.

5. New modifier
Shrinking Ray: Mini Professor Cherryz!

6. Balance changes
Blover Pot, Levitater, Sunny Pumpkin: Stats increased.
三线炮手 family: Attack speed reduced.
Buck-nut, Steel Pumpkin, Football-nut: Matching metal items restore much more HP.
Magnet Blover: Digested metal items now become drops.
Calamity-shroom and Avarice-shroom: Effects reworked. Avarice-shroom can now be used on Odyssey's Cursed difficulty.
Tridents: Attacks now slow plants with the Damp status.
Pozeidon: Can bite like a trident and strengthens Damp. The Giant Trident creates a vortex that draws in projectiles.
Trident Jugger-nut Gargantuar: No longer needs to reach the half-HP threshold before throwing its trident.

7. Other improvements
Random mode no longer starts the next wave immediately when the remaining zombies have little total HP.
Improved some plant facial animations.
Magic Plantbrush recognition now runs on a server rather than the player's device.
Adjusted the pacing of points and modifiers in classic Odyssey.

8. Fixes
Fixed Drone Commando disappearing after a scene change.
Fixed Fair Points incorrectly receiving the Cursed difficulty points bonus.
Other fixes and gameplay improvements.
